auth.termsContent:
1. Acceptance of Terms

By downloading or using Tribe Wallet ("the App"), you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the App.

2. Description of the Service

Tribe Wallet is a shared financial management app that allows you to create commitments, split expenses between groups, register payments and track balances collaboratively.

3. Registration and Account

You must create an account to use the App. You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and notifying us of any unauthorized use.

4. Payments and Sharing

The App facilitates the registration and splitting of expenses between group members. Tribe Wallet does not process bank transfers directly; all payments must be made through external means (PIX, credit card, bank slip, cash, etc.).

5. User Responsibilities

You are responsible for: providing accurate and up-to-date information, keeping your login credentials confidential, and using the App lawfully and ethically.

6. Intellectual Property

All content of the App (code, design, logos, texts) is owned by Tribe Wallet or its licensors.

7. Limitation of Liability

Tribe Wallet is not responsible for damages resulting from misuse of the App, connection failures, or financial decisions made based on the information displayed.

8. Changes to the Terms

We may update these Terms at any time. We will notify users through the App or by email.

9. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by Brazilian law. For any disputes, the forum is the user's domicile district court.

10. Contact

For questions, contact us at support@tribe-wallet.com.
auth.privacyContent:
1. Who we are

Tribe Wallet is a shared financial management app. We take your data privacy seriously.

2. Information we collect

We collect: registration data (name, email, phone), usage data (accesses and actions performed in the App), financial data (amounts, categories, payment methods registered) and device information (OS version, device identifier).

3. How we use your information

We use your data to: create and manage your account, allow expense sharing with your group, send due date and payment notifications, and improve the App experience.

4. Sharing with third parties

We do not sell your data. We share information only with other members of your group (shared expenses) and service providers necessary for the App to function (hosting, notifications).

5. Security

We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect your data, including encryption and restricted access.

6. Data retention

We keep your data while your account is active. You may request deletion at any time.

7. Your rights (LGPD/GDPR)

You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, withdraw consent, request data portability and file a claim with the ANPD.

8. Cookies and similar technologies

We may use cookies to improve the functioning and security of the App.

9. International transfer

Your data may be stored on servers located outside Brazil, always with data protection guarantees.

10. Changes

We may update this Policy. The latest version will always be available in the App.

11. Contact
